committee_papers.note: Committee reports are published here. Committee id confirmed by the Modern.gov web service on 2026-09-26.

reference_format.note: YY/<letter>/NNNNN. The middle letter is the case type: P for planning applications, D for condition discharges (e.g. 26/D/00125).

quirks.summary: keyVal is not the usual uppercase alphanumeric token: it reads like '_GUILD_DCAPR_214647', with a leading underscore and underscores inside.
quirks.detail: A keyVal grep of [A-Z0-9]+ matches nothing, so a search that returned 42 results reads as having returned none. The 2026-09-16 survey recorded 'returned nothing' here for exactly this reason.
quirks.workaround: Match keyVal=([^&"'\s]+), i.e. everything up to the next separator.

quirks.summary: At 5 s pacing the server closes idle keep-alive connections, so a script that reuses a pooled connection fails with 'Remote end closed connection without response'.
quirks.detail: Reproduced twice with a persistent Python requests session, once at the documents tab and once at the download. With one connection per request (Connection: close, or separate curl invocations) the same run completed.
quirks.workaround: Send Connection: close, or open a new connection per request, when pacing at several seconds. Keep the cookie jar; only the TCP connection needs to be fresh.

quirks.summary: Committee reports are on the council's Modern.gov committee system, not the Idox documents tab.
quirks.detail: The host and committee id are in portal.committee_papers.
quirks.workaround: For a committee decision, fetch the report, any update sheet and the minutes from the committee system before recording any of them as missing.
